name: A Dwarf and His Tools
label: Quest
description: Prospector Ryedol warns that Dark Iron dwarves, looking like the Shadowforge clan, are all around. They just attacked the dig site where Ryedol worked…
intro: Prospector Ryedol warns that Dark Iron dwarves, looking like the Shadowforge clan, are all around. They just attacked the dig site where Ryedol worked, and Ryedol wants the lucky pick back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey, friend. Be careful 'round here. There be Dark Iron dwarves all around--looked like the Shadowforge clan.
They just attacked the excavation site I was workin' at--killed nearly everyone there, including my boss Hammertoe. I barely escaped with me life.
The site's just to the north of here, and I'm tryin' to plan a way to get some of our supplies back, especially me lucky pick.
Think you'd be up to helpin' me out some? One of those damned Dark Iron must have my pick! Could be anyone of them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Not sure what the Shadowforge were lookin' for, but they definitely had a purpose.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ye're me savior, adventurer. I'm glad someone could teach those Shadowforge a lesson or two. Thanks for yer help.
